--- !bad_call_per_inline.sql
GRAPH FinGraph
CALL PER () (p) {
  MATCH (p:Person)-[:Owns]->(a:Account)
  RETURN a
}
RETURN a

--- Error
syntax error: testdata/input/gql/!bad_call_per_inline.sql:2:13: per () is not supported with inline CALL (...) { ... }
  2|  CALL PER () (p) {
   |              ^
